segments.title: Clear glass, at half strength
segments.body: With the address bar in the sidebar, in dark mode, point at a pinned tile, then at the URL field. 0.2.43-nightly.9 goes back to the clear glass from before the darker tint, at half strength: the tiles and the field rest lighter, with a softer rim, and pointing at them lifts them only a little. 0.2.43-nightly.8 tinted them darker, with a sharper rim and a bright flash on hover.

segments.title: Site controls, more solid
segments.body: Click the site controls button and point at the tiles. 0.2.43-nightly.9 makes the panel half as see-through, like Downloads, and drops the grey tint from the address field above it. 0.2.43-nightly.8 let more of the page show through.

segments.title: Glass covers the panels now
segments.body: Open Settings › Appearance and point down Interface Style. 0.2.43-nightly.9 drops the “Use glass for panels” switch: Glass puts Downloads and the site controls panel in glass too, and Classic keeps everything flat. 0.2.43-nightly.8 had that third row under the tint switch.
